profile.name: AHMED JAWAD
profile.title: Frontend Engineer
profile.bio: Information Technology graduate with experience in software development, data analysis, customer support, and web technologies. Skilled in Python, SQL, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Excel, with a passion for building practical, data-driven solutions. Winner of the AI HUB 200 Hackathon and certified by Google and IBM. A collaborative problem-solver who enjoys learning new technologies, working with diverse teams, and delivering high-quality digital solutions that create real impact.

experience.description: Led the frontend rebuild of a SaaS analytics platform used by 200+ enterprises. Took page load from 8.2s to 1.1s.
highlights: Developed responsive web pages and reusable UI components using modern front-end technologies such as React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS.
Collaborated with the development team to implement clean, maintainable, and user-friendly interfaces.
Applied best practices in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive web design.
Improved problem-solving and debugging skills while working on real-world development tasks

experience.description: Worked on the frontend of a headless Shopify storefront, achieving a 97 Lighthouse score and generating €2M in revenue in the first year.
highlights: Order Management Agent (OMA): Learned how to work under pressure and how to make the customer happy
Managed customers orders ensuring accurate process and great experience
Provided customer support via chat and calls handling problems and complains with professionalism and empathy

experience.description: Won the AI HUB 200 Hackathon, showcasing skills in AI and software development.
highlights: Developed a program to help users find the fastest route to their destination
Provided estimated arrival times for better trip planning
Programmed using Python, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to ensure functionality and a user-friendly interface

projects.title: Ebria Route Optimization
projects.description: Developed a route optimization application that helps users find the fastest route to their destination while providing accurate estimated arrival times. Built during the AI HUB 200 Hackathon using Python for backend logic and HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for the user interface.

projects.title: Responsive Web Development
projects.description: Designed and developed responsive web pages and reusable UI components. Collaborated with a development team to build clean, maintainable, and user-friendly interfaces while applying modern front-end development best practices.

projects.title: Excel Data Analysis Projects
projects.description: Performed data cleaning, transformation, and analysis using Excel. Created PivotTables, applied formulas, validated datasets, and generated charts to support data-driven business decisions.
